content: {"praised":["Acting is superb and faithful to Reginald Hill’s characters.","Realistic dialogue and authentic Yorkshire slang.","Strong, intelligent, tough detective characters.","Engaging mystery set in Yorkshire dales.","Good pacing and tone for crime drama."],"criticized":["Some episodes feel redundant and overbearing.","Gritty tone can be grating and nerve‑wearing.","Certain episodes lack pizzazz compared to earlier seasons.","Overly smart‑dummy portrayal can be annoying.","Some viewers find the pacing slow after several episodes."]}
